ensemble_rule: arithmetic mean of FP32 ONNX Runtime Web sigmoid outputs from seeds 42/43/44
guardrails: Scores are ranking outputs, not guaranteed probabilities or percentages of trust.
The 20K cohort informed the diagnostic policy comparison and is not a fresh confirmation set.
The secondary_review tier does not yet contain DNS, reputation, TLS, redirect, or page-content implementation.
The recall threshold was selected on the frozen calibration cohort, not on final-test labels.
In Normal mode, the warning and block tiers interrupt navigation; Caution remains advisory-only.
model: Updated HYB-MS +10% MS-HardGAN-C, three-seed mean-score ensemble

portability_calibration.reason: The 1% calibration-FPR point materially lowers FNR while preserving a low FPR; selection used only the frozen calibration cohort.
portability_calibration.threshold_rule: maximize recall subject to the same calibration FPR cap; break ties by F1 then lower FPR

primary_binary_rule.action: scores at or above this value are recall-oriented caution-or-higher detections

tiers.action: request independent reputation/DNS/content evidence; do not block from URL score alone
tiers.name: secondary_review

tiers.action: show passive caution; independent evidence may escalate
tiers.name: caution

tiers.action: interstitial block with explicit user override in Normal mode
tiers.name: warning

tiers.action: interstitial block with explicit user override
tiers.name: block
